title: schoenus lanatus
intro: Schoenus lanatus, commonly known as woolly club-rush, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties and is valued for its ability to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Schoenus lanatus include its potential to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce fluid retention and alleviate symptoms of edema, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The plant's therapeutic actions can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties.
